name: Zenith Healthcare Limited
about: Zenith Healthcare Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of pharmaceutical products in India and internationally. The company offers its products in the form of tablets, capsules, and liquids. It also provides contract manufacturing services of various dosage forms, including purchasing raw materials, production, packaging, and quality control. In addition, the company exports products in therapeutic segments, such as antibiotics and anti-infective, gastrointestinal, analgesic/anti-inflammatory, cardiovascular, respiratory, ophthalmology, bio-technical products, oncology, anti-retroviral, central nervous system, nutrition, genito urinary system, and skin. Further, it sells roadtep licenses products. Zenith Healthcare Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
